Rules on traits: on change / every event /
Telco trait → IAB Audience Taxonomy ID
Results land as new source data

svg.text: closed loop: outcomes become source data
Workflow & governance module — runs underneath every step
Approvals (Flowable BPMN, configurable per tenant) · no self-approval · persona rules enforced first
SLA timers · escalation to next approver · reminders · parallel branches (e.g. DPO joins only when PII is involved)
Lifecycle: draft → validated → approved → sandbox → certified → live → deprecated · every change versioned and audited
Same engine for: source contracts · schema mappings · identity merges · traits · signals · destinations · taxonomy crosswalk
Personas: Source Owner · Data Steward · DPO · Marketing Ops · Data Scientist · Ops Admin · Auditor · Tenant / Super Admin
every approval, timer and escalation above is the same workflow service (bands 1 and 2 use it the same way)
Extension on the activation / RMN side (not in the CDP spec)
